title: Planning Commission appointment fight and lawsuit
summary: On a 5-4 vote, the council rejected a nominee to the Maui Planning Commission. The vote took place at the council's February 21, 2025 meeting.

timeline.text: On a 5-4 roll call vote, the council rejected a nominee to the Maui Planning Commission.
